raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash has unit and kernel tests but no end-to-end test, so a change to a shared path can break the served model without turning any test red. This adds two nightly tests on the cookbook recipes, and installs the MSA kernels on Blackwell CI runners, which the model imports at startup there.

## Modifications

- `test_minimax_m31_flash_h200.py` (nightly, 8-gpu-h200): the H200 balanced recipe (TP8; Marlin W4A16 experts, no MSA) with DSpark and block verification. It checks GSM8K and the DSpark accept length.
- `test_minimax_m31_flash_gb300.py` (nightly, 4-gpu-gb300): the B300 balanced recipe (TP4; TRT-LLM NVFP4 MoE, MSA, DSpark) with HiCache write-through to the file storage backend. It checks GSM8K and the DSpark accept length, then reloads a long prefix from storage after `/flush_cache` and checks that the greedy output matches the GPU-cached one.
- `ci_install_dependency.sh`: on Blackwell, install MSA at the `MSA_COMMIT` of `docker/Dockerfile.cu134`, editable and with its submodules as the Dockerfile does, cached per commit under `~/.cache/sglang-ci/minimax-msa` behind a `flock`, since runner containers on one host share `~/.cache`.

## Verification

Both tests run against `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` at main 316ff4dce2; sgl-eval GSM8K, 1319 examples, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, max_tokens 8192.

| Test | Hardware | GSM8K | Accept length |
|---|---|---|---|
| H200 | 8x H200 | 0.9575, 0.9591 | 3.87, 4.19 |
| GB300 | 4x B300, MSA 1e7bf76 | 0.961, 0.961, 0.955 | 4.22, 4.18, 4.15 |

The thresholds are 0.93 (both) and an accept length of 3.4 (H200) and 3.8 (GB300). The first H200 number was measured with the same flags on main with https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46868 applied, before it merged; the second is this PR's CI run (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40914892470).

On the B300 node, MSA was installed by the same steps as the new `install_msa`; the script itself first runs on this PR's Blackwell CI jobs. Runs of the storage-reload case on three prompts, with and without DSpark, matched the GPU-cached output every time, and the full test including it passed (the third row). On a GB300 CI runner the Blackwell test passed with GSM8K 0.9560 and accept length 4.13 (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40910557761).

@@ -857,6 +857,46 @@ install_extra_deps() {
     mark_step_done "${FUNCNAME[0]}"
 }
 
+install_msa() {
+    # MiniMax MSA sparse-attention kernels: MiniMax-M3.1 imports them at startup on
+    # Blackwell. Same commit and layout as docker/Dockerfile.cu134; editable because
+    # prefill JIT-compiles against its CUTLASS submodule.
+    if [ "$IS_BLACKWELL" != "1" ]; then
+        mark_step_done "${FUNCNAME[0]}"
+        return
+    fi
+    local msa_commit msa_dir
+    msa_commit=$(sed -n 's/^ARG MSA_COMMIT=\([0-9a-f]\{40\}\)$/\1/p' "${REPO_ROOT}/docker/Dockerfile.cu134")
+    if [ -z "$msa_commit" ]; then
+        echo "FATAL: no MSA_COMMIT default in docker/Dockerfile.cu134"
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    msa_dir="${HOME}/.cache/sglang-ci/minimax-msa/${msa_commit}"
+    # Runner containers share ${HOME}/.cache: without the lock, one job's rm -rf
+    # deletes the tree another job is still cloning.
+    mkdir -p "${HOME}/.cache/sglang-ci"
+    exec 8>"${HOME}/.cache/sglang-ci/minimax-msa.lock"
+    flock --exclusive 8
+    if [ ! -f "${msa_dir}/.complete" ]; then
+        rm -rf "$msa_dir"
+        git init -q "$msa_dir"
+        git -C "$msa_dir" remote add origin https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MSA.git
+        _git_with_github_auth git -C "$msa_dir" fetch -q --depth 1 origin "$msa_commit"
+        git -C "$msa_dir" checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
+        _git_with_github_auth git -C "$msa_dir" submodule update -q --init --recursive
+        touch "${msa_dir}/.complete"
+    fi
+    $PIP_CMD install --no-deps -e "$msa_dir" $PIP_INSTALL_SUFFIX
+    if [ -f "${msa_dir}/integrations/sglang/pyproject.toml" ]; then
+        $PIP_CMD install --no-deps -e "${msa_dir}/integrations/sglang" $PIP_INSTALL_SUFFIX
+    fi
+    flock --unlock 8
+    exec 8>&-
+    python3 -c "import inference, msa_v1; print(f'MSA {inference.__file__}')"
+
+    mark_step_done "${FUNCNAME[0]}"
+}
+
 prepare_runner() {
     bash "${SCRIPT_DIR}/prepare_runner.sh"

@@ -0,0 +1,126 @@
+"""MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on GB300 with the B300 balanced recipe, DSpark and HiCache.
+
+Covers the Blackwell path: MSA sparse attention, the TRT-LLM NVFP4 MoE, the
+bundled DSpark draft, and HiCache moving the NVFP4 page rows (packed KV, block
+scales, index K and draft KV) between GPU, host and file storage.
+"""
+
+import re
+import shutil
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.default_fixture import DefaultServerBase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=2200, stage="nightly", runner_config="4-gpu-gb300")
+
+_STORAGE_HIT_METRIC = re.compile(
+    r"^sglang:storage_prefetch_hit_tokens_total(?:\{[^}]*\})? (\S+)$", re.M
+)
+
+
+class TestMiniMaxM31FlashGB300(GSM8KMixin, DefaultServerBase):
+    model = "MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash"
+    other_args = [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--reasoning-parser",
+        "minimax-m3",
+        "--tool-call-parser",
+        "minimax-m3",
+        "--tp",
+        "4",
+        "--moe-runner-backend",
+        "flashinfer_trtllm_routed",
+        "--speculative-algorithm",
+        "DSPARK",
+        "--speculative-use-block-verification",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+        "breakable",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size",
+        "32768",
+        "--max-running-requests",
+        "128",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+        "128",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.8",
+        "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
+        "--hicache-write-policy",
+        "write_through",
+        "--hicache-storage-backend",
+        "file",
+        "--hicache-storage-prefetch-policy",
+        "wait_complete",
+        "--enable-metrics",
+    ]
+
+    gsm8k_backend = "sgl_eval"
+    gsm8k_num_examples = 1319
+    gsm8k_num_threads = 64
+    gsm8k_max_tokens = 8192
+    gsm8k_temperature = 1.0
+    gsm8k_top_p = 0.95
+    # Measured 0.961 / 0.961 and accept length 4.22 / 4.18 on 4x B300.
+    gsm8k_score_threshold = 0.93
+    gsm8k_accept_length_thres = 3.8
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.storage_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="m31-hicache-")
+        cls.server_env = {
+            "FMHA_SM100_ALLOW_JIT": "1",
+            "SGLANG_HICACHE_FILE_BACKEND_STORAGE_DIR": cls.storage_dir,
+        }
+        super().setUpClass()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        super().tearDownClass()
+        shutil.rmtree(cls.storage_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+
+    def _storage_hit_tokens(self) -> float:
+        text = requests.get(f"{self.base_url}/metrics", timeout=30).text
+        return sum(float(v) for v in _STORAGE_HIT_METRIC.findall(text))
+
+    def _generate(self, prompt: str) -> str:
+        res = requests.post(
+            f"{self.base_url}/generate",
+            json={
+                "text": prompt,
+                "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "max_new_tokens": 64},
+            },
+            timeout=300,
+        )
+        res.raise_for_status()
+        return res.json()["text"]
+
+    def test_prefix_reloaded_from_storage_matches(self):
+        # Well past the 256-token storage prefetch threshold and several pages long.
+        prompt = (
+            "".join(
+                f"Ledger entry {i}: warehouse {i % 7} shipped {i * 13 % 101} crates "
+                f"to port {i % 11} on day {i % 29}.\n"
+                for i in range(400)
+            )
+            + "Question: how many crates did warehouse 3 ship on entry 101? Answer:"
+        )
+        self._generate(prompt)
+        # A cold prefill and a cache hit take different numeric paths, so compare
+        # against a GPU hit, which reads the NVFP4 pages the storage reload restores.
+        gpu_hit = self._generate(prompt)
+        requests.post(
+            f"{self.base_url}/flush_cache", params={"timeout": 30}, timeout=40
+        ).raise_for_status()
+        hits_before = self._storage_hit_tokens()
+        reloaded = self._generate(prompt)
+
+        self.assertGreater(self._storage_hit_tokens(), hits_before)
+        self.assertEqual(gpu_hit, reloaded)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+"""MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on the H200 balanced recipe with DSpark.
+
+Hopper serves the NVFP4 experts through Marlin W4A16, runs the sparse attention
+without the Blackwell MSA kernels, and verifies DSpark drafts as per-row decode
+queries, so this recipe needs no extra install on the CI runner.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.default_fixture import DefaultServerBase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=960, stage="nightly", runner_config="8-gpu-h200")
+
+
+class TestMiniMaxM31FlashH200(GSM8KMixin, DefaultServerBase):
+    model = "MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash"
+    other_args = [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--reasoning-parser",
+        "minimax-m3",
+        "--tool-call-parser",
+        "minimax-m3",
+        "--tp",
+        "8",
+        "--context-length",
+        "140000",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill",
+        "breakable",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.85",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+        "64",
+        "--speculative-algorithm",
+        "DSPARK",
+        "--speculative-use-block-verification",
+    ]
+
+    gsm8k_backend = "sgl_eval"
+    gsm8k_num_examples = 1319
+    gsm8k_num_threads = 64
+    gsm8k_max_tokens = 8192
+    gsm8k_temperature = 1.0
+    gsm8k_top_p = 0.95
+    # Measured 0.9575 and accept length 3.87 on 8x H200.
+    gsm8k_score_threshold = 0.93
+    gsm8k_accept_length_thres = 3.4
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
